n: CoderDojo Twin Cities Pico base bot
t: A low-cost Raspberry Pi Pico robot with MicroPython lessons from CoderDojo Twin Cities.
steps: Find the Base Bot lessons from CoderDojo Twin Cities.
Buy the parts and check the battery pack.
Ask IT to help install an editor such as Thonny.
Assemble the chassis, Pico, motor driver and sensor.
Test the sensor with fresh batteries.
